classification.difficultyReason: Combine equal base angles, parallel-line relationships and vertically opposite angles with linear equations.

content.prompt: In each diagram, work out the value of each pronumeral.

spec.description: Shallow isosceles triangle with horizontal base, matching single side ticks, an extended upper-right side, and a parallel sloping line through the left vertex.
spec.mathematics: The equal sides meet at the upper vertex. The right base angle is 24 degrees. The left marked angle between the upper-left parallel ray and the side to the upper vertex is 5z−18. Both sloping lines have matching parallel arrows.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the supplied labels 5z−18 and 24° appear; the value of z is hidden.

answer.worked:
The base angles are equal because the triangle is isosceles, so both are $24^{\circ}$.

$$\begin{align*}
\text{upper angle}&=180^{\circ}-24^{\circ}-24^{\circ}\\
\text{upper angle}&=132^{\circ}
\end{align*}$$

The marked angle equals the upper angle (alternate angles on parallel lines).

$$\begin{align*}
5z-18&=132\\
5z&=150\\
z&=30
\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Trapezium with parallel horizontal top and bottom sides. The top line extends past both upper vertices.
spec.mathematics: Top-left interior angle 4x, bottom-left interior angle 2x, bottom-right interior angle (x+12)°, and top-right exterior angle y between the rightward top extension and descending right side. Matching parallel arrows are present.
spec.answerVisibility: The supplied angle expressions are visible; the values of x and y are hidden.

spec.description: Right-pointing isosceles triangle with both equal sides extended through their common right vertex.
spec.mathematics: The upper-left interior angle has a leader label (2x+16)°. The lower-left angle is 68°. Matching single ticks mark the two sides meeting at the right vertex. The angle y is vertically opposite the right interior angle.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the supplied expressions and 68° appear; the values of x and y are hidden.

answer.worked:
Base angles of an isosceles triangle are equal.

$$\begin{align*}
2x+16&=68\\
2x&=52\\
x&=26^{\circ}
\end{align*}$$

The right interior angle is $180^{\circ}-68^{\circ}-68^{\circ}=44^{\circ}$ (angle sum of a triangle). Vertically opposite angles are equal, so $y=44^{\circ}$.
